title: A single smartphone notification hijacks your focus for 7 seconds, new study finds | Mint
summary: A study reveals that even a single social media notification can disrupt cognitive processing for around 7 seconds, with the magnitude of disruption linked to the frequency of notifications and how often individuals check their phones, rather than total screen-on time.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses the negative impact of frequent notifications and constant phone checking on cognitive processing and attention, indicating a negative market impact.
